open_points.subject: issue_contract_version validation order
open_points.text: “It checks the purpose rule first … then the A02 rule 1 conditions in their order … It computes contract_version_id … an equal version is returned unchanged … the A02 rule 1 ceiling checks bind only a new version”
open_points.question: Must the implementation compute and look up the content identity before applying current-release ceiling checks, or must it validate the ceilings before discovering that the version already exists?
options: Compute the identity after the purpose check, return an existing equal version, and apply A02 checks only when creating a new version
Apply A02 checks before identity lookup, so an existing equal version can be refused under lowered release ceilings
open_points.default_guess: Compute and look up the identity before A02 checks, then validate A02 only for a new version.

open_points.subject: TrialExecution file-output disclosure class
open_points.text: State 4 says “records a file output by its facts only (M07), each with the highest class of the case's inputs”, while M07 defines those file facts as “digest, size and media type” only.
open_points.question: Does a trial file-output reference store a disclosure class, or is that class only derived from the trial case's inputs when the execution is read?
options: Store only digest, size and media type, deriving the class from the case inputs
Add disclosure_class to each trial file-output reference
open_points.default_guess: Store only the M07 facts and derive the class from the case inputs.

open_points.subject: submit_implementation response when the serving implementation is refused over a grown corpus
open_points.text: Step 6 returns an activation “when one was written or already current”, but the Outcomes section says “when admitted an Activation by the kernel”.
open_points.question: If the submitted implementation is already active but receives a refused verdict over the current grown corpus, does the response include its still-current Activation?
options: Include the current Activation together with the refused verdict
Return an Activation only when the current submission's verdict is admitted
open_points.default_guess: Include the current Activation because it remains the serving activation even though the new verdict is refused.

open_points.subject: standing-grant target validation
open_points.text: “grants a node of the flow's active version … whose class is not destructive”
open_points.question: What happens when the requested node does not exist or is a function node and therefore has no operation effect class?
options: Refuse the grant because only an existing operation node can be granted
Treat the target as grantable because it is a node of the active version
Return no grant without a refusal
open_points.default_guess: Refuse unless the target is an existing operation node of the active flow version.
